finding.omission: The registered exact work table counted census and at most eight H11-P256 actions per outcome but did not include the action transitions and chance/runout operations required by its own passive exact terminal-closure contract.
finding.why_structural: A scientifically successful run is allowed to enter passive closure in up to five percent of outcomes. Therefore it can exceed the registered action-transition cap while remaining otherwise valid. Removing the closure violates the estimand; ignoring its work violates resource and abort accounting.

judgment: Freeze F8R2 permanently. Never implement,repair,rerun,reclassify or use it as route evidence. A fresh materially corrected identity may retain the scientific hypothesis only after explicitly bounding passive action and chance work and projecting those bounds through the frozen resource rates.
route_effect: No exact-V5.5 teacher science occurred and the family remains open.
